fields.label: Auto-generated by ICA
fields.helpText: EXPERIMENTAL | This input form was auto-generated from the nextflow.config file. To edit the input form go to the Pipeline > Edit > Inputform files.

fields.label: Sample manifest (required)
fields.helpText: The only input you must provide. Everything below has a working default.

fields.label: Sample manifest
fields.helpText: Sample manifest CSV/TSV. Points at the sequencing data (h5ad_path) and carries the optional gRNA/hashtag whitelist paths and, once filled in, the five QC thresholds below. A run that reaches the QC stage writes those thresholds back into this file (with a timestamped backup made first), so use a manifest you're fine having edited, not a read-only reference copy.

fields.label: Input/output options
fields.helpText: Where results are published.

fields.label: outdir
fields.helpText: Output directory. Each manifest gets its own subfolder here: <outdir>/<manifest-name>/analysis_outputs/. Use an absolute path to storage on cloud infrastructure.

fields.label: publish_mode
fields.helpText: How published files are placed in outdir (Nextflow publishDir mode: copy, symlink, link, move, rellink, copyNoFollow). Leave as 'copy' unless you have a specific reason to change it.

fields.label: Run mode
fields.helpText: The pipeline is explore-first: a manifest with no QC thresholds set stops after QC review, and needs to be run a second time (after the thresholds are filled in) for the full report.

fields.label: mode
fields.helpText: default: let the manifest's threshold state decide (explore first, full once thresholds are set). explore: always stop after QC. auto: skip the review step, run end-to-end on thresholds derived from the data.

fields.label: QC thresholds
fields.helpText: Per-cell QC gates. Leave all five blank to have them derived from the data (recommended for a first pass). These override anything already set in the manifest.

fields.label: min_genes
fields.helpText: Minimum genes detected per cell. Leave blank to derive from the data.

fields.label: max_genes
fields.helpText: Maximum genes detected per cell. Leave blank to derive from the data.

fields.label: min_counts
fields.helpText: Minimum total UMI counts per cell. Leave blank to derive from the data.

fields.label: max_counts
fields.helpText: Maximum total UMI counts per cell. Leave blank to derive from the data.

fields.label: max_mito
fields.helpText: Maximum percent mitochondrial reads. Leave blank to derive from the data.

fields.label: Transcriptome / clustering options
fields.helpText: Normalisation, embedding and clustering. All optional; defaults match a typical single-condition Perturb-seq run.

fields.label: conditions
fields.helpText: Manifest columns to use as comparison axes, space-separated (e.g. 'fixation gRNA_method'). Leave blank to autodetect.

fields.label: batch_correct
fields.helpText: Batch correction on the embedding. 'harmony' corrects the PCA, which propagates to clusters, UMAP and E-distance effect sizes -- refused if the resolved batch key is also a declared condition column.

fields.label: resolution
fields.helpText: Leiden clustering resolution. Leave blank for the tool default (1.0).

fields.label: n_top_genes
fields.helpText: Number of highly variable genes. Leave blank for the tool default (5000).

fields.label: doublets
fields.helpText: Run scrublet doublet annotation. Off by default: scrublet assumes a heterogeneous population, so its scores aren't informative for a homogeneous line. Doublets are never dropped either way, only flagged.

fields.label: no_cell_cycle
fields.helpText: Skip cell-cycle scoring.

fields.label: regress_qc
fields.helpText: Regress sequencing depth and %mito out of the embedding. Off by default -- it only affects clusters/UMAP/E-distance (never DE results) and is the longest step in the stage.

fields.label: low_memory
fields.helpText: Trade speed for peak memory (skips copying the input matrix, smaller DE gene blocks).

fields.label: counts_layer
fields.helpText: Read raw counts from adata.layers[NAME] instead of X. Use when X holds normalised/log-transformed values.

fields.label: subsample_cells
fields.helpText: Randomly subsample to at most N cells after loading. Escape hatch for a very large experiment that won't fit in memory.

fields.label: cluster_col
fields.helpText: Name of an existing obs column holding cluster labels, to reuse instead of reclustering. Requires PCA, UMAP AND this column all present in the input.

fields.label: hvg_batch_key
fields.helpText: Make highly-variable-gene selection batch-aware on this manifest column. Do not point it at a condition column.

fields.label: force_recompute
fields.helpText: Ignore QC/embedding/clustering/doublet calls already present in the h5ad; recompute everything from raw counts.

fields.label: skip_input_check
fields.helpText: Skip the plausibility check that the expression matrix is real gene expression. Only for a matrix already validated by other means.

fields.label: Guide calling
fields.helpText: How guide-RNA assignment decides which guide (if any) a cell carries.

fields.label: guide_min_reads
fields.helpText: Minimum guide UMIs for a cell to be eligible for assignment. Leave blank for the tool default (10).

fields.label: guide_purity_min
fields.helpText: Minimum top1/(top1+top2) percent required to assign a guide. Leave blank for the tool default (75).

fields.label: ntc_label
fields.helpText: Label used for non-targeting controls.

fields.label: dual_guide
fields.helpText: Dual-guide (iBAR) handling. 'auto' detects dual-guide libraries from guide-ID structure and is correct for almost every library -- only override this if autodetection is getting it wrong for your library's naming scheme.

fields.label: Hashtags
fields.helpText: Hashtag demultiplexing thresholding, when the experiment used cell hashing.

fields.label: hto_threshold_mode
fields.helpText: How the per-hashtag positivity threshold is chosen.

fields.label: hto_quantile
fields.helpText: Background quantile used as the threshold when hto_threshold_mode is background_quantile. Leave blank for the tool default (0.99).

fields.label: Report
fields.helpText: Controls over the HTML report itself.

fields.label: title
fields.helpText: Report title. Defaults to the experiment ID guessed from the manifest/output path.

fields.label: max_de_targets
fields.helpText: Cap on perturbations sent to differential expression. Leave blank for the tool default (40).

fields.label: link_figures
fields.helpText: Link figures instead of embedding them. Smaller HTML, but the report is then no longer a single portable file.

fields.label: no_tables
fields.helpText: Omit data tables from the HTML (the CSVs are still written to tables/).

fields.label: Advanced / escape hatches
fields.helpText: For cases the options above don't cover. Most users will never need these.

fields.label: config
fields.helpText: JSON or YAML file of perturbseq_report configuration overrides, for settings with no dedicated option above.

fields.label: extra_args
fields.helpText: Any other perturbseq-report CLI flag(s), passed through verbatim.

fields.label: pipeline_dir
fields.helpText: Internal: where the vendored perturbseq_report package lives, computed automatically from this checkout's own location. Do not edit -- the value shown here is only a snapshot from whichever commit/run last populated this form, not a fixed path; leaving it untouched lets nextflow.config recompute it fresh for the checkout actually being run.

fields.label: Toggle Advanced Options
fields.helpText: Show/hide options that were marked as hidden in the nf-core inputs schema.

fields.label: Preset Test Profiles
fields.helpText: Set analysis inputs to those defined in the Nextflow profile. You can then change them as you wish before launching the pipeline.
